approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: A message/rfc822 attachment must remain inert; MIME traversal must not add its body or nested attachments to the parent email analysis.
Reuse Python standard-library MIME parts and the existing attachment-boundary rule, add no dependency, and advance the parser version.
title: Nested email attachment isolation
objective: Stop parent-email MIME parsing at every attachment boundary so an attached email body or its nested files cannot become parent evidence, workflow role or attachment inventory until explicitly imported.
